title: Emulsified Dense Vietnamese Rainbow Trout Mi Quang
description: A tangy and dense Vietnamese dish featuring rainbow trout, this mi quang recipe is a quick fix for a delicious meal, and is ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Add the rainbow trout fillets to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until they are cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the fish sauce, lime juice, and grated ginger to make the emulsified sauce.
To assemble the mi quang, place some cooked noodles on a plate, then add a piece of the cooked trout, and spoon some of the emulsified sauce over the top.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
Repeat the assembly process for the remaining ingredients.
